text:
Maya: proposal \u2014 one webinar with two sequential 'labs' (startup then enterprise) + unified panel. single registration, segmented followups. yes/no?
Jorge: yes. registration should ask track choice + 'most important metric' (latency/cost/security). add hidden UTM fields.
Priya: we'll A/B test two abstract variants (how-to vs business outcomes), keep copy <80 words. i'll draft assets: 2 landing heroes, 2 email subjects, 3 social posts.
Leah: suggested run-of-show:
00:00 Welcome + agenda (Maya)
05:00 Startup lab: architecture + 8m demo (Rae)
18:00 Enterprise lab: deployment patterns + 8m demo (Hamid)
30:00 Ops mini-deep-dive: batching/quantization checklist (Jorge) 10m
40:00 Unified panel + live Q&A (Leah) 20m
60:00 Close + CTAs + resources
Tom: rehearsals: tech check 3 days out, full dress 1 day out. calendar-bot: "Tech check: 2026-04-12 09:00 UTC; Dress: 2026-04-14 15:00 UTC"
Maya: speakers confirmed? Rae/Hamid/Jorge + Leah moderates.
Rae: confirmed. will send 5min demo script by EOD.
Hamid: confirmed; prepping compliance slide + fallback video.
Jorge: tracking: registrations by track, abstract conversion, colab clicks, demo plays, MQLs by metric. set UTM campaign naming.
Priya: post-event kit: Colab sandbox + 5 starter prompts + cost/latency checklist in follow-up email.
Tom: fallback plan: pre-record demos, have pivot script. Leah will call the pivot. I'll post a short tech checklist in #eng-runtime.
Maya: action items: Priya assets due Tue; Jorge reg + UTMs due Wed; Tom pre-records + checklist due Wed; speakers slide decks + demos EOD tomorrow; Leah panel q's by Fri.
Leah: I'll also prep 6 cross-cutting questions tying both tracks to practical outcomes.
Maya: locking plan unless objections. :thumbsup:
